items.title: Show HN: Hallucination-as-a-service – API for AI excuses

I've been wanting to build a small, silly side project for a while. Something simple, fun, and not necessarily meant to solve an actual problem. So I built Hallucination as a Service (HaaS). The idea is pretty straightforward: an API that returns random excuses for when AI fails to complete a task. It's obviously a satirical take on all the AI hype we've been hearing lately.
